title: mathfin-foundry run record (v1)
description: One NORMALIZED telemetry record per (subject x attempt x stage), DERIVED (never authored) from runs/*.jsonl by probe/provenance.py. Grain: a draft record per (issue x refill-history attempt); a prove record per (target x prove-summary). Per-stage fields that the source stream does not carry are null (an honest gap, not a fabrication). One substrate for the obstruction census, the price-sheet decision, and any future meta-review.

record_id.description: sha256[:16] of the identifying tuple (stage, issue, target, attempt, outcome, gate, ts, source_file); stable across rebuilds and the dedup key

stage.description: draft = refill (magistral intent + leanstral/claude formalize); prove = vibe/text-loop

target.description: the queue target id, e.g. cal-bk-88

attempt.description: draft = the refill-history attempt index; prove = the prover round count

outcome.description: draft = the attempt's gate (or the tick outcome for a no-history seed); prove = the summary outcome

gate.description: the draft gate this attempt died at; null for prove and for seeds

family.description: the obstruction family (classify_refill) carried on the draft record; null for prove

detail.description: free-text rejection detail from the draft history row

model.description: the prover model (prove summary); null for draft (not recorded per-stage today)

tokens.description: tokens for this record; prove summary carries it, draft rows do not (aggregate lives on the tick)

ts.description: ISO-8601 timestamp from the source record

source_file.description: basename of the jsonl this record was derived from
